verdict.rationale: Codex Plugins documentation repeatedly references the official Codex CLI, including specific commands (/plugins, /skills, $skill-installer, codex plugin marketplace add) that let an AI-native user browse, install, and manage plugins/skills directly from the CLI, confirming an official CLI workflow exists and is documented as first-class. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of CLI usage beyond vendor docs, and a full command reference showing breadth of CLI capabilities.
